home.h1_start: We design wood spaces that age
home.manifiesto_text: Caoba does not manufacture furniture: it composes spaces. Each project begins with a piece of wood and ends with a place where a life unfolds better.

servicios.h1: A studio that designs, builds and maintains.
servicios.subtitle: We operate at the intersection of interior architecture, artisan cabinetry and technical maintenance of noble surfaces.
servicios.cta_sub: Starting a project takes between 12 and 24 weeks.

nosotros.subtitle: Quality is a decision of scale.

contacto.h1: Every project begins with a conversation.
contacto.subtitle: Tell us about your space. We will tell you if we are the right studio.
contacto.disclaimer: We respond within 48 business hours. Starting a project takes 12 to 24 weeks.
